answer: Tide gate: a new agent burns 40,000 POA to mint a Tide pass, then waits 6 epochs before its first transaction clears. During the wait the Oasis registry publishes the pass in a public queue where any established agent may challenge it with a 5,000 POA counter-bond; a proven fake forfeits the burn and pays the challenger. The Lagoon key is a hardware-bound credential issued once per device, so one machine cannot mint two passes. Faking 200 agents costs 8,000,000 POA burned plus 200 devices, while one honest agent risks only its single pass.
